research_source.note: Research, not a profit claim (PDF footer).

metrics._note: packet-specific metrics (e.g. results, pnl, settled_join_n); null until measured

fee_regime.feebook_formula_id_status: standing pin (R1-P1); required for fee-honest claims

fee_account_version_manifest.note: Placeholder only. Archivist is drafting; contents and formula ids NOT assumed. Examiner consumes once filed and pinned.

common_scorecard._block_note: All values null until measured on a frozen packet. Name list per p16 'The common scorecard': "Track net P&L with and without rewards; calibration; fill rate; adverse selection after fills; feasible versus requested size; unresolved inventory; capital-hours; drawdown; and event concentration." Definitions quoted from p15-16; where p15-16 gives no formula, formula='pending_definition' (not invented).

net_pnl_without_rewards.definition: p15 'Separate the profit sources': "Report trading P&L excluding rewards, exchange rewards actually earned, fees, inventory liquidation or settlement, and capital cost." p15 'Binary expected value': "expected net value per contract is q - p - net fees - other costs" (q conditional on info AND on our order filling); "Exit-based strategies must model realized entry and exit cash flows instead of replacing them with terminal payoff."
net_pnl_without_rewards.definition_status: partial_from_pdf (components named; no realized-P&L formula given)
net_pnl_without_rewards.feebook_formula_id_rule: fee-honest claims require the standing R1-P1 feebook formula_id pin
net_pnl_without_rewards.fee_components_source_note: p15 'Fees must be versioned': "Prefer actual recorded fee components."; "The repo's older cent-ceiling convention requires a version-and-account reconciliation, not an assumption that one formula covers every historical and current trade."

net_pnl_with_rewards.definition: p15/p16: "net P&L with and without rewards"; rewards component = "exchange rewards actually earned" (not an ideal estimate). p15: "Do not hide a negative forecasting strategy inside a positive subsidy."
net_pnl_with_rewards.definition_status: partial_from_pdf (no explicit formula; composition = net_pnl_without_rewards + rewards_actually_earned is NOT asserted here)
net_pnl_with_rewards.feebook_formula_id_rule: fee-honest claims require the standing R1-P1 feebook formula_id pin

rewards_actually_earned.definition: p15: "exchange rewards actually earned" ... "do not count an ideal reward estimate as cash received."
rewards_actually_earned.definition_status: partial_from_pdf (cash received, not estimate; no computation method given)

calibration.definition: Named in p16 common-scorecard list only; no definition, method or unit on p15-16.
calibration.context_outside_p15_16: p5: "Weight forecasts using past out-of-sample calibration"; p9: "Estimate calibration by family, horizon, price, liquidity and maker/taker side." (context only; not a p15-16 definition)

fill_rate.definition: Named in p16 list only; no definition/denominator/unit on p15-16.

adverse_selection_after_fills.definition: p15: "q must be the probability conditional on the information and the fact that our order fills. A maker's unconditional forecast can be right while its filled orders are systematically bad." No measurement horizon or formula on p15-16.
adverse_selection_after_fills.context_outside_p15_16: p9 reject rule: "selected fills lose more than unselected quotes" (context only)

feasible_vs_requested_size.definition: p15 'Capacity is a first-class output': "record executable dollars per day ... A 20% return on $5 of available depth is a curiosity ... A quote can disappear, and consuming it changes the opportunity." p15: "competing bots must share cash, queue and exit depth." No ratio/formula given.

unresolved_inventory.definition: p15: profit source "inventory liquidation or settlement" reported separately. No definition of 'unresolved' (count vs. mark vs. exposure) on p15-16.

capital_hours.definition: p15 headline: "Optimize risk-adjusted net dollars per constrained capital-hour"; p15: "For each candidate record ... capital-hours". No formula (what capital, which clock) on p15-16.

drawdown.definition: p15: "stress drawdown" (capacity record). p16 list: "drawdown". No formula/window on p15-16.
drawdown.definition_status: partial_from_pdf (named as stress drawdown; formula pending_definition)

event_concentration.definition: p15: "Contracts on one election, game, weather system or crypto price path share risk. Event-cluster uncertainty matters more than the raw number of fills or timestamps." p16: result must survive "without dependence on one exceptional event." No concentration statistic given.

controls._block_note: Controls apply per packet. Each is null / not-applicable until that packet's freeze declares it. p16: "Compare with market-only, simple-model and no-trade controls where relevant." p15-16 give no further definition of each control.

market_only.note: null until packet freeze declares applicability; context p5 (card 01): "market-only, model-only and hybrid baselines" and "Reject if its gains disappear against market-only" (context only).

simple_model.note: null until packet freeze declares applicability; which simple model is packet-specific and must be frozen, never chosen after peek.

no_trade.note: null until packet freeze declares applicability; context p9: "Compare equal-risk maker, taker and abstention policies" (context only).

proposed_optional._block_note: Extra items on p15-16 NOT in the Conductor list. Listed only; not adopted as scored fields. Null. Adoption requires Conductor decision.

uncertainty_by_event_or_day.quote: p16: "Report uncertainty by event or day"

sensitivity_worse_queues_latency_costs.quote: p16: "sensitivity to worse queues, latency and costs"

study_label.quote: p16: "Mark each study as unit-only, synthetic, historical replay, prospective shadow or live."
study_label.owner_note: Archivist labeling task per Conductor routing

attempted_variants_log.quote: p16: "Limit candidate variants; log every attempted variant."

period_separation.quote: p16: "Separate discovery, tuning and untouched evaluation periods."

preregistration_checklist.quote: p16: "Freeze the market universe, exclusions, receipt-time information set, fee regime, order timing, sizing, fill model, stopping rules and evaluation metrics before the test."

single_event_dependence.quote: p16: "survives reasonable stress without dependence on one exceptional event"

common_scorecard_rules: All common_scorecard values are null and measured=false until measured on a frozen packet with artifacts.
Never back-fill any common_scorecard or control field from scout N, unit-test counts, fixtures, admit flags, or estimates.
Definitions marked pending_definition must not be given an Examiner-invented formula; a packet freeze (or a later Conductor-ratified template revision) must declare it before scoring.
net_pnl_with_rewards and net_pnl_without_rewards are always reported side by side; neither is omitted when the other is reported.

Rewards-inclusive P&L never substitutes for without-rewards P&L in a KEEP decision unless the packet freeze declares it. Basis p15: "Do not hide a negative forecasting strategy inside a positive subsidy. Likewise, do not count an ideal reward estimate as cash received." Even when declared, both remain reported.
rewards_actually_earned counts only rewards actually earned/received; ideal/estimated rewards are inadmissible (p15).

Fee-honest P&L claims require feebook formula_id astra.r1p1.feebook.claude_order_level_ceil.v1 (standing R1-P1 pin) and, once filed, a pinned Archivist fee/account-version manifest; until the manifest is filed, its reference stays null/pending and no manifest contents or formula ids are assumed.
Controls (market_only, simple_model, no_trade) are per packet; applies/result stay null (not applicable) until the packet freeze declares them.
Template revision only: adding fields here does not re-score, re-open, or alter any existing stamped verdict.
